text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The hell is this crap code? Writin' the 
same damn logic over and over for nothin'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Besides, what's the deal with reusing 
variables like that? There's no naming 
convention or anything—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, dammit!! How deep do you expect me 
to dig?! It's not like I'm doing 
archaeology here, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur clutched his head in 
frustration over the horrible spaghetti 
code written by someone else.
